payload.entry: Landing verified (bob-cli-an.6.6.land, 2026-10-24). All five phases are closed, and each phase's task was closed with rechecked evidence. b3: the rfserver suspension bucket uses REMOTE_ADDR only, tailnet 724837f patches reverse-apply on the live ~/db/bin, the test copy is identical, all 3 regressions pass live, the listener is 127.0.0.1:23401 only, and the process restarted after the edit. b2: verify_root_cron 105/105; the first post-fix anacron pass advanced daily (00:42 EDT) and weekly (01:19 EDT) past their -2 rotations, with md5-identical restore samples; monthly is accepted on the shared backup.sh path, next due ~2026-11-21. 2q: see below. 85: static CID TrueType faces, adapter self-test with pdffonts passes on master, 0.00% PDFKit damage against a 6.52% baseline. 9a: relative, ./ and absolute spellings plan the same ref/chat note and reading task live. The day_timezone=config decision was honored. EPIC-CAUSED REMAINDER FIXED BY THE LANDER: 339578cb routes highlights_ref capture dates and gkeep created dates through the configured timezone, removes the web-clip converted-font /tmp dir at exit (each render leaked ~1.8 MB), and moves env.rs tests to the end of the file (an 'items after a test module' lint introduced by the epic). 05443159 runs a DATE clock command in the configured timezone; the dotfiles export DATE=date on Linux, so before this fix apollo login shells still used UTC. Both hosts were pulled and reinstalled at 05443159, and apollo with DATE=date and host-local 2026-10-23 20:42 names the Eastern day 20261024 in bob plan and capture -d. just check passed (5377 tests) and docs-check passed. INTEGRATION: the only post-start commit, a08581d8 (13i, stale Highlights saves), has no date or PDF-path interaction; it also regenerated decisions.md. FOLLOW-UPS: 6.6.3 #1 and 6.6.4 #4 (decisions.md drift) are duplicates of bob-cli-b6, which a08581d8 resolved; docs-check passes, so b6 was closed with evidence and no new task was created. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries. No epic symbols. Remainder done directly rather than through a tale, because it was small and the continuation contract requires this lander's single proposal for the successor batch.

POST-CLOSE LANDER ADDENDUM (same turn): a CI review after closing found an epic-caused macOS regression. fb535ef6's relative-path test failed on macos-latest at every commit from fb535ef6 to 339578cb, hidden because master CI was already red on b5. Cause: the physical cwd (/private/var) missed the configured lib/ spelling (/var), so sync planned a flat ref note; any symlinked vault would hit the same path. Fixed in c7e0dab6 (rebase onto the lib/xlib spelling when only a symlinked directory differs, plus a Linux symlinked-vault regression that fails without the fix). CI run 40081848753 on c7e0dab6: test (macos-latest), test (ubuntu-latest), and package all succeed; lint fails only on the pre-existing bob-cli-b5 git-identity node. Both hosts were reinstalled at c7e0dab6. Other triage: created bob-cli-b9 (large flake) for the unrelated, intermittent macOS aliases::completion_offers_group_members_status_flags_and_alias_options failure (2/7 runs, linked to bob-cli-3j); +1'd bob-cli-5l for an ETXTBSY repro in highlights_ref fetch tests. The epic stays closed: reopening would also reopen closed ancestors bob-cli-an.6 and bob-cli-an.

CONTINUATION (bob-cli-an.6.6.land, 2026-10-24): after landing, a fresh enumeration found 133 unresolved tasks: 129 ready and 4 snoozed (3o, 6q, aa, ah). None are claimed or in progress. The successor epic 'Backlog batch 4: green bob-cli CI, capture flag guard, bob-plugins red tests, and relation-label race' was authored, validated, and is being submitted through sase plan propose (scratch sase_plan_backlog_batch4_ci_identity_capture_flags_plugin_tests_relation_race.md). It owns exactly bob-cli-b5 (ci-scripts-identity), bob-cli-8a (capture-flag-guard), bob-cli-6v and bob-cli-7i (plugins-red-tests), and bob-cli-al (relation-label-race). All four phases are independent. It carries one reviewer decision (capture_flag_guard, default refuse) and the continuation contract, with item 3 re-ranked. Ranking: no actionable security or content-loss task; silent corruption first (8a, al), then 7i (dangling BLOCKS write plus deterministic test, +19), then CI blockers b5 (master lint red since 134016ce, blocking the release train and masking regressions) and 6v (+24). Deferred with reasons: b7 ties 6v but loses on corroboration and age; 79 fails loudly; b8 needs a reviewed live-vault mutation; 4r affects 2 notes; 7q is a design change. Next candidates: 2l, 94, 95, 4r, 79, b8; CI b7; flakes 3w, 5l, b9, 4k, 8q; Athena b4, ax, 8r, 9x. The backlog campaign is not complete.
